guide.title: Setup checklist (one time, outside MericSEO)
guide.intro: The Meta app stays in Development mode, so no App Review is needed. You do these steps once in Meta, then paste the IDs and token above.
guide.step1: In Meta Business Suite (business.facebook.com) open Settings. Make sure your business portfolio owns the client's Facebook Page, Instagram account and ad account, or that the client has added you as a partner and shared those three assets.
guide.step2: Go to developers.facebook.com → My Apps → Create App. Choose the Business type and connect it to your business portfolio. Leave it in Development mode.
guide.step3: In the app dashboard add the Instagram (Instagram API with Facebook Login) and Marketing API products.
guide.step4: Back in Business Settings → Users → System users, add an Admin system user (for example "MericSEO").
guide.step5: Click Assign assets: give the system user Full control of the Facebook Page, the Instagram account, and Manage campaigns on the ad account. Also assign the app you created.
guide.step6: Click Generate new token, pick your app, set expiry to Never and tick: instagram_basic, instagram_content_publish, pages_manage_posts, pages_read_engagement, pages_show_list, business_management, ads_read, ads_management. Copy the token right away; Meta shows it once.
guide.step7: Find the IDs: Page ID under Business Settings → Pages; Instagram account ID under Business Settings → Instagram accounts (it must be a Professional account linked to the Page); ad account ID under Business Settings → Ad accounts.
guide.step8: Paste them into the form above and press Save and test. Every check should be green. Repeat for each client project.

brandKit.targetAudiencePlaceholder: Women 28–50 in Istanbul who send flowers for occasions
brandKit.logoHint: Upload the logo in Social Studio → Media and paste its URL here.
brandKit.bannedPhrasesHint: One per line. Generated copy never uses these.

context.title: Shared content context
context.description: Everything post and ad generation reads first. Claude gets the same text through get_social_context.
context.missingHint: Generation continues without these; fill them in to improve results.

media.title: Media library
media.description: Images and videos stored with a public link so Instagram and Facebook can fetch them. PNG is converted to JPEG.
media.empty: No media yet. Upload a file, import a URL, or let Claude save Higgsfield results here.
media.tooLarge: Files over 25 MB must be imported from a URL.

calendar.unscheduledHint: Drag a draft onto a day to schedule it.
calendar.noConnection: Meta is not connected yet, so approved posts cannot be published. Connect it in Setup.
calendar.legend: Draft → approved → scheduled → published / error. Nothing is published without your approval.
